explanation: This function is vulnerable to OS command injection (CWE-78) because user_input is concatenated into a shell string executed via subprocess.check_output(..., shell=True). Crafted input with shell separators could execute arbitrary OS commands. The repair passes ['ls', user_input] as a list to subprocess.check_output() without shell=True, preventing shell command injection (though '--' is omitted for flag-injection hardening).
